english_description: StickLib, a legacy public dump of StickMUD (turn-of-century LPMud 2.4.5 lineage on the LDMud driver, with later GMCP/MSSP/MXP/MSP/MCMP protocol work). LDMud → FluffOS conversion: catalog overlay for login/look/score/quit; original /secure/master_ldmud.lpc keeps set_driver_hook and closures. Live StickMUD historically at stickmud.com. Not collection ageofelements (different 2.4.5 fork).
